deployments_detail.use: Guanlan multi-modal large model for computer vision/NLP AIoT video perception

Guanlan Large-Scale AI Models: Hikvision's proprietary suite of large multimodal/vision AI models pre-trained on deep industry knowledge, embedded at the edge to power AIoT products for perception, inference and natural-language analysis of image, video, voice and environmental data. [Hikvision (proprietary Guanlan models)]

AcuSeek NVR: network video recorder built on a large multimodal AI model that lets users search recorded footage for specific people or objects using natural-language text/voice queries (open-vocabulary object detection), returning results within seconds. [Hikvision (Guanlan multimodal model)]

DeepinViewX cameras: network cameras equipped with Guanlan large vision models for advanced video content analysis, vehicle feature recognition, PPE-violation and smoking detection, doubling VCA range and cutting perimeter false alarms. [Hikvision (Guanlan vision models)]
deployments_detail.value: perimeter false alarms cut by over 90%; double VCA range; repeated alarms halved

deployments_detail.use: AcuSense technology: deep-learning algorithms embedded in select security cameras and video recorders to automatically classify and detect humans and vehicles, reducing false alarms and improving perimeter monitoring efficiency. [Hikvision (proprietary deep learning)]

ANPR (Automatic Number Plate Recognition): DeepinView-series LPR cameras use deep-learning algorithms to automatically read and recognize vehicle license plates across 120+ regions for traffic, parking and access control. [Hikvision (proprietary deep learning)]

Smart-city surveillance deployment in Shanghe County, Shandong Province, China: ~1,900 Hikvision cameras with integrated facial recognition connected to the regional 'Sharp Eyes' platform under a 12-year public-private partnership. [Hikvision (facial recognition)]

WonderOS 4: operating system for Hikvision interactive education/collaboration displays that embeds Wonder AI tools (AI Identify, AI Notes, omi) with cloud-integrated architecture to assist teaching and meetings in smart classrooms. [Hikvision (Wonder AI)]

Neural Labs vehicle-analytics AI (Neural Edge) embedded in-camera on Hikvision DeepinView-Series 7-Line cameras to deliver advanced vehicle analytics for road safety and traffic efficiency. [Neural Labs (on Hikvision DeepinView cameras)]

Hikrobot machine-vision systems: deep-learning visual inspection deployed in electronics and semiconductor manufacturing to detect surface defects (scratches, damage, spots, missing/overlapping printed characters) at ~100ms inspection speed for quality control. [Hikrobot (Hikvision subsidiary)]

HikCentral Lite v1.1.1 video management software enhanced with the AI-powered AcuSeek platform, adding AI-driven natural-language video search and unified management (video, access control, alarms) for facilities of any size. [Hikvision (AcuSeek / Guanlan)]
